title: GCP-7.1: handoff replay-state transfer unimplemented - link_epoch/link_seq never initialize the new gateway link replay window
close_reason: GCP-7.1 handoff replay-state transfer implemented per the spec amendment (syml, completing the lost l1qw.23.1 scope): HandoffConfirmCosePayload in python/src/lichen/gateway/handoff.py gained replay_bitmap (confirm key 7, 32-bit uint, bit i = link_seq - i). Validation: 0 <= bitmap <= 0xFFFFFFFF and bit 0 MUST be set (the old gateway accepted link_seq itself — matches C replay window invariant where bit 0 is always set once tracking). CBOR encoding includes key 7; from_cbor requires the full 7-key set (conforming senders unaffected; non-conforming rejected). Tests: roundtrip with bitmap, bit-0-clear rejected, out-of-range (-1, 1<<32) rejected, missing-key rejected. The new gateway reconstructs its replay window as floor (link_epoch, link_seq) + bitmap (bit i = link_seq - i), closing the in-window gap replay hole the floor-only transfer left. Verification: 35/35 handoff tests, 285/285 handoff+gateway suite, ruff clean (3 UP038 pre-existing at HEAD via stash — kpv0.3 scope). Codereview (Kimi K3): PASS; validation ordering confirmed correct (32-bit range precedes bit-0 check since Python -1 & 1 == 1); bool-admits-int laxity noted as consistent with the file's existing _strict_uint pattern. Rust/C handoff implementations consume this amendment as separate work.
